title: plectranthus gymnostomus
intro: Plectranthus gymnostomus, commonly known as Vicks plant, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It is valued for its health benefits, particularly in treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Plectranthus gymnostomus include relieving coughs, colds, and sore throats, as well as its ability to soothe digestive issues. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as camphor, 1,8-cineole, and borneol, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
